title: Photo 242 · 텐트폴 USSBBW · 마욜리카 · 옆으로 누운 자세 · 한국 30대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 30s, warm ivory skin tone with a soft golden undertone, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, tight cornrows swept into a thick low bun, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears long linear drop earrings and has tapered almond nails with metallic tips.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so long and vast that her head and her feet are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A giant hourglass frame that flares out at both ends: enormous flaring lats spreading to shoulders twice the width of a normal woman's, massive rounded deltoids stacked on top of them, huge thick arms pushed far out from her sides by the width of her back, a smooth rounded neck, a colossal bust projecting forward past the line of her shoulders, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and, even as she lies on her side, spills forward away from her body and hangs over the front edge of her torso under its own weight, the lowest part sagging down onto the platform, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one in front of the other, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Below it colossal wide hips just as broad as her shoulders, a huge rounded rear, colossal thighs pressing together down to the knees and thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame and her shoulders span more than five head-widths. Wide above and wide below; the muscle is huge but rounded and soft-edged under a thick layer of fat, no bodybuilder look. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it spills forward, sags downward and presses flat against the platform beneath her.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Italian maiolica tin-glaze style — a glossy warm cream glaze ground painted with cobalt blue, ochre yellow, copper green and manganese purple grotesque scrolls, acanthus leaves and medallions, a bold cobalt band following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Lying on her side on the platform facing the camera, her head resting on her raised hand with that elbow planted on the platform behind her body so her arm never crosses in front of her torso, her other arm lifted clear of her body and resting lightly on the top of her hip with the elbow raised, a visible gap of background between that arm and her side so the whole curve of her waist, hip and belly reads unbroken, her legs stacked one on the other with the knees slightly bent, her upper hip rising as a great rounded mound higher than her own shoulder and the underside hip and thigh flattening wide where they press against the platform, her body stretching across the full width of the frame from edge to edge.

Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto sandals with a wide ankle cuff, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the cobalt and ochre glowing on the cream glaze, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation full-body photograph, wider than it is tall.
